title: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1

full_text:
Article 9 (Vice-Ministerial Coordination Meeting)
(1) The Chairperson may have a vice-ministerial coordination meeting held before the Strategy Meeting for its efficient operation.
(2) The vice-ministerial coordination meeting shall consult on and coordinate the following matters:
1. Matters delegated to it by the Strategy Meeting in connection with agenda items submitted thereto;
2. Other matters for which the Chairperson deems prior consultation between ministries or agencies necessary.
(3) The Second Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism shall chair the vice-ministerial coordination meeting, whose members shall be vice-minister-level officials from ministries or agencies related to the agenda item. <Amended on November 5, 2019>
